meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求迁移时,它会扫描已有的 OpenClaw 安装,读出身份、渠道凭据、定时任务和配置,分板块和你确认要把哪些内容搬到 v2 的哪里,展示拟改动后才执行。
howto.when: 当你说“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”等词,或要求把 OpenClaw 迁移/导入到 NanoClaw v2 时触发;标准位置没检测到安装时会询问自定义路径。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask to migrate it scans your existing OpenClaw install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks and config, then walks you through each area and shows proposed changes before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" and similar phrases, or when you ask to import OpenClaw into NanoClaw v2. If no install is found at standard paths, it asks for a custom path.
